video_title: Toumani Camara Media Availability | Oct. 9, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on his growing leadership role with the Blazers
quotes.excerpt: They want me to be more vocal, more present just because the way I show up every day.
quotes.quote: I think the respect from the coach, from my teammates, and they're pushing me to do it. They want me to be more vocal, more present just because the way I show up every day with my energy and my style of play. I think it's just something that I gain from the players and from everybody from the organization, just the respect to be a leader and try to help the team keep the mindset the right way and the effort the right way.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara says the Blazers coaching staff and his teammates are pushing him to step into a more vocal leadership role this season

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on the mutual respect and accountability among teammates
quotes.excerpt: We got a lot of good guys, man, a lot of guys that respect one another.
quotes.quote: We got a lot of good guys, man, a lot of guys that respect one another and believe in one another. So it could be anybody. It could be J Kent, or it could be me, or it could be Dame saying something. We are all listening to the same level of attention, so a lot of respect and attention for one another.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara highlights the accountability in the Blazers locker room noting that anyone from veterans to younger players can step up and lead

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on Chauncey Billups' direct and calculated coaching style
quotes.excerpt: He understands players, he understands how the system goes, so everything is calculated.
quotes.quote: You can tell he's been around for a long time. He understands players, he understands how the system goes, so everything is calculated. The way he communicates to us, the way he is, how I play for, and easy to talk to he is as a human, it makes it easy to work with somebody like that. Somebody that's so open-minded, that lets you have your input, let you ask questions, and go treat you the right way.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara praises Chauncey Billups for his open communication style and for being a coach who is easy to talk to and receptive to player input

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on the value of intense practice sessions
quotes.excerpt: We need those stopping moments, you know, we're going to have ups and downs.
quotes.quote: We need those stopping moments, you know, we're going to have ups and downs. There's going to be days where we come in and the arena, we have a game day and the energy is not going to be there and the head of the snake, the head coach, or the leader of the team, no matter what, got to respond and wake up your team and make them realize this is not how we're supposed to play, this is not how we're supposed to move. So I can do nothing but respect that.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara emphasizes the importance of intense practice sessions and the need for leaders to hold the team accountable when energy levels drop

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on the team's selfless culture and lack of ego
quotes.excerpt: When it's time to work, it's time to work, you know, he's all about the business.
quotes.quote: When it's time to work, it's time to work, you know, he's all about the business and at the same time he's a simple human. I think like all of us, we have a lot of great people out here, great people in this organization, and he fit right in with his character and his ethic of work and yes, it's been great.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara says Chauncey Billups fits the culture of the organization perfectly due to his work ethic and character

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on the team's selfless approach to offensive play
quotes.excerpt: Everybody is willing to pass it and nobody is going to just go out there and jack up shots.
quotes.quote: Probably this one to be honest, just because how much talent we have, how easy it is to move the ball. Right now we're still trying to figure it out, you know, because we have two guys that haven't played in a long time, so for them coming back and finding their rhythm and guys like me, like City, trying to find a way to complement them. We're all trying to figure it out right now, but very unselfish. Everybody is willing to pass it and nobody is going to just go out there and jack up shots and try to be the hero every night.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara says the Blazers are currently working through finding their offensive rhythm but notes that the team is very unselfish and nobody is trying to be the hero

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on the importance of checking egos for team success
quotes.excerpt: When we all truly appreciate one another, there's no ego off the court.
quotes.quote: I feel like with this team is we all care about one another. I feel like that's something that helped for sure. When we all truly appreciate one another, there's no ego off the court, nobody's trying to take anybody's spot or just separate themselves more than others. We're just trying to win together, you know, and I think when you have that type of mindset, that type of energy within the team, it's hard to have a selfish team. Everybody care for one another defensively, offensively, so I think that's how we can thrive.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara believes the lack of ego on this Blazers roster is the key to their success saying we are just trying to win together

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson's growth and maturity
quotes.excerpt: To me, he put it together. Scoot always been super athletic, super fast, great finisher, great driver.
quotes.quote: To me, he put it together. Scoot always been super athletic, super fast, great finisher, great driver, great shooter, and I feel like now mentally he just put it all together. How can he affect the team defensively, how scrappy he could get, and offensively make the right play every time. I think there's no one time this summer where I'm like, 'You should have done this, Scoot.' Every time he drive and making a decision, it's the right one and it's the one that we need for the team.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara says Scoot Henderson has put it all together mentally this summer noting that every decision he makes on the court is the right one
